# Mork table grouping keeps raw row IDs distinct from message keys and header IDs

The parser groups rows by resolved table scope while keeping raw hexadecimal @id strings and scope metadata. Readable message output derives a numeric messageKey separately; messageId comes from the message-id header. Clear-row and continuation handling apply before grouping. Do not turn a review request for numeric IDs into the landed raw-output contract: exact source keeps strings. The parser and test match the fixed accepted blobs; callers were checked separately.

Scope: Mork parser grouped output identity.
